messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Of course, Saturday was a complete no-no as my back had completely seized up.

output.original_text: Of course, Saturday was a complete no-no as my back had completely seized up.
output.joy: Of course, Saturday was a bit of a no-go since my back just needed some rest!
output.sadness: Of course, Saturday was a total no-no as my back had completely given out.
output.fear: Of course, Saturday was a total no-no because I was terrified my back might give out completely.
output.anger: Of course, Saturday was a total no-no; I can't believe my back seized up like that!
output.surprise: Of course, Saturday turned into a no-no, and I was shocked when my back just seized up completely!
output.disgust: Of course, Saturday was a complete no-no; it was disgusting how my back had seized up like that.
